mobilisation_advance.quote: The Authority shall make an interest-bearing advance payment (the “ Advance Payment”) @ “ Bank Rate+ 3% ”, equal to 10 % (ten percent) of the Contract Price, exclusively for mobilisationexpenses.
mobilisation_advance.note: Interest rate is specified as Bank Rate + 3% per annum. Deductions start from the first Stage Payment Statement and must be fully repaid before 80% of the Construction Period is over.

retention.quote: the Authority shalldeduct6%(sixpercent)thereof as guarantee money for performance of the obligations of the Contractor during the Construction Period (the “ Retention Money”) subject to the condition that the maximum amount of Retention Money shall not exceed5% (five per cent) of the ContractPrice.
retention.note: Retention money balance is refunded within 15 days of issue of the Completion Certificate.

billing_cycle.quote: The Contractor shall submit a statement (the “Stage Payment Statement”) , in 3 (three) copies, by the 7th (seventh) day of the month to the Authority’s Engineer
billing_cycle.note: Monthly stage payment statements are raised by the 7th day of each month.

payment_period.quote: payment shall be made no later than 30 (thirty) days from the date of submission of the Stage Payment Statement by the Contractor to the Authority’s Engineer

liquidated_damages.note: Clause 10.3 (iii) caps total damages at 10% of the Contract Price.
